title: FRB: FEDS Notes: The recent slowdown in high-tech equipment price declines and some implications for business investment and labor productivity
关键词: Federal Reserve Bank of San Francisco (FRB)
主要内容: The Federal Reserve Bank of San Francisco (FRB) reported in FEDS Notes on March 26, 2015, that high-tech equipment price declines slowed, affecting business investment and labor productivity. High-tech equipment investment, driven by falling prices, contributed to productivity growth since the 1970s, but spending remained weak during the current recovery. Labor productivity growth slowed since 2010, with high-tech capital deepening contributing 0.3 percentage points to productivity growth, down to 0.1 percentage points. The slowdown in business spending is linked to a decline in the price index used to deflate high-tech equipment investment in NIPAs. The report suggests the slowdown may be overstated due to measurement issues, including shifts in computer investment toward imports and challenges in accounting for product quality improvements.

股票实体.名称: Federal Reserve Bank of San Francisco
